name: Hearthgate
description: Play with friends on other networks with no port forwarding, accounts, or extra software: share a singleplayer world, or keep a dedicated server reachable (with Discord announcements). Peer-to-peer WireGuard tunnels built on Tailscale's open-source Tailcat library, running entirely inside the game. An independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tailscale Inc.
